translations.tech.grouping_strategy_hint: Half-beat grouping keeps the current grid; KPS uses a fixed single-finger threshold; Tempo Window estimates a one-hand window from chart speed and the BPM threshold.
translations.tech.single_finger_kps_hint: This value groups close attacks; it is not a measured human speed limit. Changing the grouping policy invalidates cached traces.
translations.tech.kps_bpm_hint: KPS grouping uses its single-finger threshold to form runs; the BPM threshold and speed-segment BPM limits do not affect this policy.
translations.tech.piece_fallback_hint: Cuts half-beat pieces and alternates hands. When one hand cannot hold a dense run, the previous main-hand piece is re-cut before output. Results differ from other groupings; verify in game.
translations.tech.lazy_release_hint: Plain presses stay down until the same key is needed again, then release just before that press. Used to observe dense-section disconnects. Off by default; verify in game.
translations.tech.hand_policy_preferred: Prefer starting hand after a gap
translations.tech.run_hand_policy_hint: Alternation is the default. The preferred-hand option reuses the starting hand after at least one current grouping window since its last attack; otherwise it alternates. This is a comparison rule, not a human recovery model.
translations.tech.tempo_window_bpm_hint: Combines per-floor speed and the BPM threshold into a run window that can only stay fixed or tighten within a group. The selected run hand rule chooses the hand, whose available keys cap the group size.
translations.tech.bpm_explanation: Per-floor speed and this BPM threshold define the base slice length. One hand can play multiple events in a slice.
translations.tech.player_driver_hint: Time playback follows the song clock; angle playback gates events by the current floor. Changes apply on the next level entry or retry.
translations.tech.player_angle_lead_hint: Angle-driver triggers are quantized to the frame rate, so they can land up to one frame late; raise this if it feels late.
translations.tech.player_prewarm_hint: The trace is generated and cached when the level finishes loading. If the chart and technique settings match a compatible cache, it is reused.
translations.tech.player_solve_now_hint: Prepare the current level’s trace using the same technique core as level loading; reuse a matching cache if available.
translations.tech.player_io_hint: Export the current level's .adofaitrace file to share; importing requires the same level + same technique config (fingerprint check). Takes effect on next level entry.
translations.tech.segment_inherit: Empty key fields inherit the global configuration.
translations.tech.order_format: Order format: pipe separates key-count groups, comma separates indices (1-based). Empty = default.
translations.tech.use_rust_trigger_hint: The key-firing thread uses the embedded Rust kernel for timing and falls back to C# if the kernel is unavailable or errors. The technique trace is unchanged.
